title: Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat
author: Samin Nosrat
summary: Samin Nosrat explains cooking through four elements, salt, fat, acid and heat, and shows how understanding them lets you cook well without a recipe, with illustrations and a set of basic recipes.
readIf: you want to become a more confident, intuitive cook instead of following recipes step by step.
skipIf: you want a large collection of recipes or fast weeknight meals.
